title: Coral and the Choir
author: N. M. Nakamura
blurb: Ines Yarrow, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
